profile.bias: last closed HTF context must be directionally available
profile.zone: canonical FVG/OB on ITF with valid lineage
profile.retest: first subsequent closed M15 candle returning to the validated zone
profile.entry: last confirmed opposite swing on exec TF; closed-candle close fallback
profile.sl: sweep wick on M15 plus/minus 0.3 times the mean closed M15 range
profile.tp: deterministic 3R level; expose opposing-liquidity extreme for consumer validation
profile.timezone: UTC canonical; killzone conversion uses engine.killzone

limitations: This freeze covers the intraday M15 profile only.
M5/M1/scalping and a separate M15 execution dataset require a future authorized freeze or data gate.
